name: tracking-working-time
description: Menu bar app for macOS that tracks active working time with a strict five-minute idle rule. Electron, TypeScript and React.
author: Minh Khoi Ha

scripts.dist: npm run check && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.screenshots: electron-vite build && node scripts/seed-demo-data.mjs screenshots && electron . --screenshots=screenshots
